theater: 山西雲州與木雞山一線

battle.name: 雲州之戰
battle.theater: 山西雲州與木雞山一線
battle.brief: 永淳元年（682）秋，東突厥阿史德元珍率騎兵寇唐雲州，唐將薛仁貴以二百死士出城夜襲，據木雞山，擊潰來敵，記斬首萬級、獲生口二萬餘。卡面的羅馬方陣盾從未入唐，它標示的是以盾結陣抵禦投射的兵器譜系；雲州唐軍真正靠的是城牆、弩、拒馬，以及這支敢於出城的奇兵。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐王朝與東突厥汗國。唐方的雲州是北邊邊防體系的一環，隸山西道，設雲州都督與屯田大使，轄境在今山西朔州一帶，與內長城、定襄、馬邑連成一條南北向的防線；守軍由關中、河東調來的府兵與北邊募來的邊兵、屯田戶混編，唐初府兵制在此時已開始鬆散，邊軍中募兵與長駐屯戶的比例日增，指揮上由行軍總管、行軍大將軍一類臨時職銜分道節制，節度使建制尚未出現。雲州屯田的產出以軍糧與馬匹為主，兼供雁門、代州一線，糧秣轉輸靠畜力與人力，沿途沒有便捷的水路。突厥一方是漠北的游牧聯盟，汗庭在陰山以北，兵員是各部落的騎兵，按部落編為部，大戰時由可汗與諸部首領合兵，攜帶帳幕、輜重、備馬與牧群作戰；騎兵是全部戰力所在，攻城器械與強攻能力有限，遇上唐軍城守，多採掠地而去的用法，奪取邊地的牧場、馬群與糧食正是戰爭的主要目的。兩邊的體量差異很大：唐以城與屯田守線，突厥以騎兵與季節性機動攻線；而682年秋季，東突厥汗國又正逢內部權力交替，邊線上的衝突因此格外密集。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tang dynasty and the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. On the Tang side, Yunzhou formed one link in the northern frontier system. It belonged to the circuit of Shanxi and had a Yunzhou commandery and a commissioner of tuntian farming, its territory covering the area around present-day Shuozhou in Shanxi, joined to the inner rampart and to Dingxiang and Mayi in a north-south defensive line. Its garrison mixed government militia drawn from the capital districts and Hedong with recruited frontier soldiers and farming households; the militia system of early Tang had already begun to loosen, and recruited men and permanently stationed farmers made up an ever larger share of the frontier force. Command was divided among ad hoc titles such as the Grand Commander of Marching Forces and the Commander-in-Chief of Marching Troops, and the permanent office of regional military governor did not yet exist. The output of the Yunzhou farms was chiefly military grain and horses, with part of it going to the Yanmen and Daizhou lines; grain and stores were moved by animal and human power, and there was no convenient water route along the way. The Turkic side was a nomadic confederation in the northern steppes, with its court north of the Yin Mountains. Its soldiers were the cavalry of the separate clans, organised by tribe, and in a great campaign the khan and the clan chiefs brought their armies together, carrying tents, baggage trains, remounts and herds with them. The cavalry was the whole of its fighting power; siege engines and a real capacity for storming walls were limited, and faced with a defended Tang town the usual practice was to ride off with the plunder, for seizing the pastures, horse herds and stores of the borderland was the point of the war. The scale difference between the two was very great: the Tang held its line with towns and farms, the Turks attacked that line with cavalry and the seasonal mobility of herds. And in the autumn of 682 the Eastern Turkic Khaganate was in the middle of a struggle over authority inside its own camp, which made contact along the frontier unusually frequent.
people: 主角是薛仁貴（614—683），字仁貴，河東薛氏之後、隋代大將薛安都的六世孫，祖籍河東汾陰，生於絳州龍門。他早年在高句麗戰事中以白衣方天戟、兩張弓衝陣嶄露，參與平定高句麗時升至右威衛大將軍、封平陽郡公；咸亨元年（670）在大非川敗於吐蕃，被廢為平民，開耀元年（681）因舊功復起，為瓜州長史、右領軍衛將軍、檢校代州都督，上元年間又因子事貶發象州，遇赦得還，兩度起伏之後才得到本役的差遣。突厥方面的主將，《新唐書》記為阿史德元珍，領兵入寇雲州；汗庭的主人則是東突厥可汗骨咄祿，其弟思摩在汗國內部與他相爭，682年骨咄祿死後，汗位繼承之爭隨即公開化，這是理解本役時機的關鍵背景。唐廷方面，永淳元年是唐高宗李治在位、武則天以皇母之尊臨朝聽政的時期，朝令多由中樞與內廷商定，邊將更替與獎賞往往出於一時之斷。雲州主帥一項，舊籍多繫於都督劉仁願——這位曾隨軍滅百濟、參與白江口之戰的老將——記他畏敵閉城，與薛仁貴主動出擊形成對照；另有一系記載只說薛仁貴奉命征討而不載主帥姓名，兩說並存，本卡採並列的寫法。
peopleEn: The central figure is Xue Rengui (614-683), courtesy name Rengui, of the Xue clan of Hedong and a sixth-generation descendant of the Sui general Xue Andao, whose family came from Fenyin in Hedong and who was born at Longmen in Jiangzhou. He first made his name in the war against Goguryeo, riding in white armour with a fangtian halberd and two bows at his waist, and he rose to Right Martially Valiant Guard General and was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang when Goguryeo was brought to terms. After his defeat by Tibet at Dafeichuan in Xianheng 1 (670) he was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner; in Kaiyao 1 (681) the emperor recalled his old services and restored him as Chief Administrator of Guazhou, Right Army Leading General and acting commander of Daizhou, and in the Shangyuan years he was demoted again and sent to exile in Xiangzhou, winning his return through a general pardon. It was only after this second fall that he received the commission for the present battle. On the Turkic side the commander is given in the New Book of Tang as Ashide Yuanzhen, who led the incursion into Yunzhou; the master of the steppe court was the Eastern Turkic khan Qutlugh, whose brother Simmo was contesting him inside the khaganate, and after Qutlugh died in 682 the struggle over the succession broke into the open, which is the key background for reading the timing of this campaign. In the Tang, Yongchun 1 was a time of Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi with Empress Wu Zetian ruling as empress dowager; court orders were settled largely between the central secretariat and the inner court, and the rotation of frontier commanders and the granting of rewards were often the work of a moment's decision. On the question of the commander at Yunzhou, the older records usually attach the command to the commanderate holder Liu Renyuan, the old general who had served in the conquest of Baekje and in the battle of Baekgang, and they describe him as shutting his gates in fear of the enemy, a sharp contrast with Xue Rengui's willingness to attack. Another line of record says only that Xue Rengui was ordered to meet the enemy and does not name the commander. Both versions stand, and this card records them side by side.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是羅馬方陣盾（scutum），公元前二世紀末共和末期成型、帝國時期定為軍團制式：半圓形，上下兩端削平，高約一百零五至一百一十公分，寬約七十五至八十公分，木芯蒙皮，外沿包金屬釘與皮條，內側有橫握把與一個中央握把，凸面弧度大，重約七到十公斤。羅馬人用它的方式不是靠厚度，而是靠盾緣互相咬合成連續防線：前列持矛刺擊、次列掩護、後列投射標槍，盾牆在推進中吸收箭矢，盾手在隊形邊緣受到保護；到近戰距離，盾後的短劍才派上用場。這面盾從未出現在唐土——羅馬與唐之間沒有任何軍事接觸——它在這張卡上標示的是「以盾結陣抵禦投射」這一兵器譜系，以及它所對應的那種面對高速騎兵衝鋒的解法。雲州之戰的唐軍沒有這種大盾：守軍用皮甲與札甲，配臂弓、角弓與擘張弩、手弩，步兵持小盾與長矛、環首刀，城頭架床弩，城門內塞拒馬、鹿角與橫木，壕溝外加木柵；出城的一支二百人奇兵靠的是速度、弓弩與突刺，並非結陣。突厥騎兵則是角弓長矢、刀、矛、革盾與大量備用馬匹，掠奪的目標包括羊群、馬群與帳幕物資；戰果記載中駝馬牛羊三萬餘頭的數目，正說明這是一場以牲畜為核心資源的邊境掠奪。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scutum, a shield that took shape in the late Republican period of the second century BC and was fixed as legionary issue in the imperial period. It is half-moon shaped with the top and bottom cut flat, about 105 to 110 centimetres high and 75 to 80 wide, a wooden core covered in hide, the rim fitted with metal studs and leather strips, a horizontal grip and one central handle inside, strongly convex and weighing some seven to ten kilograms. The Romans used it not for its thickness but for the way one rim locked into the next, forming a continuous line: the front rank thrust with the long spear, the second covered them, the rear rank cast the pilum, and the wall of shields absorbed missiles while it advanced, the shield-bearers protected at the edges of the formation; only at close quarters did the short sword behind the shield come into play. This shield never reached Tang territory, for there was no military contact between Rome and Tang. On this card it marks the line of shields used to form a formation against incoming missiles, and the kind of answer it offered to cavalry charging at speed. The Tang force at Yunzhou had no such large shield. The garrison wore hide and lamellar armour and carried bows of the arm-drawn and horn-composite kinds, the powerful drawn crossbow and the handheld crossbow; infantrymen held small shields with long spears and ring-pommel swords; bed crossbows stood on the parapets, while inside the gates were chevaux-de-frise, antler obstacles and beams, with a wooden fence outside the ditch. The sortie of two hundred men relied on speed, bows and the sudden thrust, not on any close formation. The Turkic horse carried composite bows with long arrows, sabres, spears, hide shields and a great many remounts; what they came for was the flocks, the horse herds and the tent goods of the borderland, and the figure of more than thirty thousand head of camels, horses, cattle and sheep in the booty record says plainly that this was a border raid fought over livestock.
tactics: 雲州一線的常規守禦是閉城以待：敵騎至則城門閉塞，壕溝填塞，拒馬與鹿角塞住門道與衝撞地帶，城頭弓弩交替射擊，覆蓋城牆外的射界；等敵人馬疲、糧水乏，或分兵掠地時再尋隙反擊。本役的轉折是主將不欲出戰、而屬下請求以少量死士出奇制勝。薛仁貴募得二百名自願出城的死士，趁夜離城，趨木雞山一帶據高，先以火光與鼓噪製造唐軍大隊已到的假象，讓突厥騎兵誤判而稍退；接著現身，脫去兜鍪讓對方認出自己，敵軍驚懼失色、下馬羅拜而稍稍退走，唐軍乘勢自高處衝下，追擊潰散之眾。整個過程倚賴三件事：情報上摸清敵營位置與進攻方向；地形上木雞山一帶的高地，居高可以放火箭與火把，也便於短兵衝鋒；士氣上靠二百死士的士氣與唐軍名將的威名壓住對方的騎兵。追擊之後是清點與繳獲：游牧軍隊的帳幕、備馬與牧群是實際所得，這也是唐廷衡量勝敗的另一套標準。
tacticsEn: The standing defence of the Yunzhou line was to shut the town and wait. When the horse came, the gates were barred, the ditch filled in, chevaux-de-frise and antler obstacles jammed the gateways and the ground where a charge would land, and bows and crossbows on the parapet fired in turn to sweep the ground outside the walls; a counter-stroke was looked for only when the enemy horses were tired, their water and stores exhausted, or their columns spread out to plunder. The turn of this battle lay in a commander unwilling to leave the walls and a subordinate who asked to go out with a handful of men and win by surprise. Xue Rengui raised two hundred volunteers willing to die, slipped out of the town by night, and took the heights around Mukishan, where they first used firelight and beating drums to make it seem that the main Tang army had arrived, so that the Turkic horse misjudged the situation and drew back a little. He then showed himself, took off his helmet so that they would recognise him, and the enemy, struck with fear, changed colour, dismounted and made obeisance before slipping away; the Tang troops charged down from the height and pursued the broken columns. The whole business rested on three things: intelligence on the position and direction of the enemy camp; the high ground around Mukishan, from which torches could be thrown down and at which close fighting was possible; and the morale of two hundred volunteers, together with the fame of a Tang commander, applied to the morale of the opposing horse. After the pursuit came the counting and the taking of spoil, for the tents, remounts and herds of a nomadic army were the real prize, and they were the standard by which the Tang court judged such a victory.
data: 先看地理。雲州城在今山西朔州，北緯三十九點三度、東經一百一十二點四度；木雞山的地望有異說，或指朔州以北、或指忻州原平一帶的山地；陰山在雲州正北約二三百里，突厥騎兵越陰山南下只需數日；長安到雲州直線約一千一百公里，折合唐里約二千二百里，行軍須經河東，糧秣靠沿途州縣與雲州屯田供應。兵力方面，唐方出擊的隊伍是二百人，這是本役最確鑿的數字；雲州守軍的具體人數，史料沒有留下記載，只能依當時邊軍與屯田的規模推想為數千之眾。突厥方面，舊新唐書多作萬餘騎或數萬，這些是概括說法，沒有可核的依據。戰果記載則彼此打架：《新唐書》記斬首萬級、獲生口三萬，《舊唐書》記獲生口二萬餘人，斬首萬級、駝馬牛羊三萬餘頭；一場由二百人奇兵造成的戰鬥卻報出數萬俘虜，內部既不自洽，也與唐代其他戰役的記數風格相近，宜視為唐方誇飾性的記數，而不是實測值。薛仁貴於永淳元年冬前後返朝受賞，翌年（683）病逝，朝廷追贈左驍衛大將軍、幽州都督。本役之後，雲州防線的實際守軍編制、人員與糧秣數量，史料皆無記載，本卡不補。
dataEn: Start with the ground. The town of Yunzhou stands at present-day Shuozhou in Shanxi, at 39.3 degrees north and 112.4 degrees east. The whereabouts of Mukishan are disputed, being placed either north of Shuozhou or among the hills around Yuanping in Xinzhou. The Yin Mountains lie some two or three hundred li due north of Yunzhou, and Turkic horse needed only a few days to cross them and come south. The direct line from Chang'an to Yunzhou is about eleven hundred kilometres, roughly two thousand two hundred Tang li, and an army marching that way went through Hedong, drawing grain and stores from the prefectures on the way and from the farms of Yunzhou. On numbers of men, the Tang force that attacked was two hundred, and that is the firmest figure in the whole story. The strength of the Yunzhou garrison itself is not recorded anywhere and can only be imagined, from the scale of frontier troops and farms at the time, as a force of some thousands. On the Turkic side the two Books of Tang speak of ten thousand riders or of tens of thousands, which are general statements without anything that can be checked. The records of results contradict one another: the New Book of Tang has ten thousand severed heads and thirty thousand prisoners taken alive, the Old Book of Tang more than twenty thousand prisoners alive together with ten thousand heads and more than thirty thousand head of camels, horses, cattle and sheep. A battle fought by two hundred men of the Tang cannot yield tens of thousands of captives; the figures are not internally consistent and resemble the recording habits of other Tang campaigns, and they are best read as the inflated numbers of the Tang side rather than as measurements. Xue Rengui returned to court and was rewarded around the winter of Yongchun 1; in the following year, 683, he fell ill and died, and the court posthumously granted him the rank of Left Light Cavalry General and Commander of Youzhou. The actual establishment, strength and stores of the Yunzhou garrison after the battle are nowhere recorded, and this card supplies nothing for them.
cause: 打起來有遠因，也有近因。遠因是唐初對突厥的政策成功之後，東突厥汗國在陰山以北重建，而唐廷的邊防線並沒有隨之調整：貞觀末年唐太宗連年用兵高句麗、壓服吐谷渾，府兵出於關中、久戍不歸，府兵制的戰力與後備同時被削弱，太宗一死，邊防實際交給剛即位的兒子與臨朝聽政的武則天。永淳元年前後的唐廷正在經歷一輪人事與政策的劇烈調整，新進將領與舊有河隴集團互相排斥，邊軍的指揮與補給時常中斷，雲州這樣的屯田邊州更是重點防守、也更容易出漏洞。近因是東突厥的內部變動：骨咄祿在位時汗國漸強，兄弟之間的權力之爭讓本部落的忠誠度下降，一些騎兵在秋末南下，試圖以邊地的牲畜與糧食度過寒季，同時藉機削弱唐的邊防。直接導火線沒有留下可靠記錄，只能從邊地常見的畜牧糾紛、馬市交易與叛部歸附一類的事情去推測；史料只說突厥大軍已至雲州城下，沒有記下第一箭是怎麼射出去的。
causeEn: There were distant causes and immediate ones. The distant cause is that after the success of Tang policy against the Turks in the early years of the dynasty, the Eastern Turkic Khaganate was rebuilt north of the Yin Mountains, while the Tang frontier line was not readjusted to match. In the last years of Zhenguan Emperor Taizong campaigned repeatedly against Goguryeo and against the Tuyuhun, so that the militia was drawn out of the capital districts and away for long years, and both the fighting quality and the reserves of the militia system were weakened. When Taizong died the frontier in practice passed to his newly enthroned son and to the empress who governed as regent. The Tang court around Yongchun 1 was passing through a violent reshuffling of men and policy: newly promoted officers and the old Guanzhong and Longyou families excluded each other, the command and the resupply of the frontier armies were repeatedly interrupted, and a farming outpost like Yunzhou, which was a focus of defence, was also a place where holes could easily appear. The immediate cause was a change inside the Eastern Turkic khaganate. Under Qutlugh the khaganate had grown strong again, but the quarrel between brothers lowered the loyalty of the clans, and some of the horse came south in late autumn, meaning to live through the cold season on the livestock and stores of the borderland and at the same time to weaken the Tang defences. No reliable record survives of the spark itself; it can only be guessed at from the sort of things that were common on the frontier, quarrels over herds, horse-market dealings and the return of renegade clans. The histories say only that the Turkic host had reached the foot of Yunzhou, and they do not record how the first arrow was fired.
impact: 對唐廷而言，本役的直接結果是雲州守住，北方邊線沒有被突破，這在太宗剛崩、朝局未定的年份意義不小：它證明邊軍雖缺援、雖無帥才，只要有一個敢於出兵的指揮官，城防加奇兵仍然可以把騎兵擋在牆外。對薛仁貴自己，這一仗是他復起之後的第一場大勝，唐廷賞賜其錦袍與勳位，他由被貶的閒人重新變成朝廷倚重的邊將，名聲在數年內傳遍關中。歷史上的影響更見於後世形象：他白袍將軍的裝束、三箭定天山與雲州大捷被說唱與戲曲反覆搬演，元雜劇有《薛仁貴衣錦還鄉》，明代有《白袍記》，於是唐代邊防的實戰細節被改造為市井英雄敘事，這套敘事至今仍在。制度上，邊軍屯田、募兵與臨時行軍職銜的弊端在這幾年裡被反覆暴露：劉仁願那樣的老將守城畏戰，主帥與屬下互不信任，靠一個二百人奇兵補上整條防線的漏洞，是唐代邊防體系真實運作的寫照。更長遠的後果則來自對手：東突厥在骨咄祿死後因內訌而加速崩解，687年薛仁貴在天山以北再破突厥，唐廷得以在陰山一線重新立定，至690年代汗國瓦解，部眾分化，其中一支日後演為回鶻。
impactEn: For the Tang court the direct result was that Yunzhou held and the northern line was not broken, and that mattered in the years just after Taizong's death, when the government was unsettled: it showed that even a frontier army short of support and short of competent commanders could keep horse out of the open as long as there was one officer ready to attack, walls plus a sortie. For Xue Rengui himself this was the first great victory after his restoration, the court rewarded him with brocade robes and rank, and a man who had been demoted to idleness became once more an officer the state relied on, his fame spreading through Guanzhong within a few years. The historical influence is even clearer in the later image of him: the white armour of the general in a white robe, the three arrows that fixed the Tian Shan, and the great victory at Yunzhou were worked over again and again in storytelling and drama, from the Yuan play Xue Rengui Returns in Splendour to the Ming White Robe Tale, so that the practical detail of Tang frontier fighting was recast as a popular hero narrative that is still with us. Institutionally, the weaknesses of farming garrisons, of recruited troops and of ad hoc marching commands were laid bare again and again in these years: an old commander like Liu Renyuan shut his gates in fear, the commander and his subordinates did not trust one another, and a sortie of two hundred men was what patched the hole in an entire defensive line, which is a true picture of how the Tang frontier system actually worked. The more remote consequences came from the other side: after Qutlugh's death the Eastern Turkic khaganate fell apart faster because of its internal quarrels, and when Xue Rengui broke the Turks again north of the Tian Shan in 687 the Tang could set itself once more on the Yin Mountains line; by the 690s the khaganate had dissolved, its clans divided, and one of the groups that emerged from it would later become the Uyghurs.
result: 結果有兩層。軍事上，雲州城未失，突厥騎兵在木雞山一線受挫退走，唐記斬首萬級、俘獲生口二萬餘至三萬、繳獲駝馬牛羊三萬餘頭，薛仁貴因此名重一時；這些數字雖與史實的比例不合，仍是當時唯一流傳下來的記數，後世講這場戰役都照單引用。政治上，東突厥並未因此被重創，汗國的分裂反而加速：骨咄祿死後，汗位由其子咄毘與其弟思摩爭奪，兩造內戰消耗了汗國的力量，也讓唐廷得到喘息與反攻的機會。戰役之後數年，劉仁願在寶山一線的失利暴露了邊軍統制的脆弱，他被貶誅，薛仁貴也一度再被貶到象州；直到開耀、開封年間薛仁貴重新出山、在天山以北大破突厥，北方邊線才真正穩住。也就是說，雲州之戰是一場以小搏大的邊防奇襲，它保住了當時的雲州，卻沒有解決東突厥，也沒有解決唐代邊防體系本身的問題——這兩件事最後分別由突厥的內潰與唐廷的體制調整來收尾。
resultEn: The result has two layers. Militarily, the town of Yunzhou was not lost, the Turkic horse was checked and turned back on the Mukishan line, and the Tang records claim ten thousand severed heads, between twenty and thirty thousand prisoners taken alive, and more than thirty thousand head of camels, horses, cattle and sheep; Xue Rengui became a name of weight overnight. Those figures do not match the proportions of the case, but they are the only numbers that came down to us, and later accounts of this battle quote them without qualification. Politically, the Eastern Turks were not badly hurt, and the division of the khaganate only quickened: after Qutlugh died the succession was fought over between his son Dubi and his brother Simmo, and the civil war between them drained the khaganate's strength while giving the Tang court room to breathe and to counter-attack. In the years after the battle the defeat suffered on the Baoshan line exposed how fragile the control of the frontier armies had become; Liu Renyuan was demoted and put to death, and Xue Rengui was sent down to exile in Xiangzhou once more. Only when he came back into service and broke the Turks north of the Tian Shan in the Kaiyao and Kaiyuan years did the northern line truly settle. In short, the battle of Yunzhou was a border sortie fought two hundred against thousands: it saved Yunzhou for the moment, but it neither settled the Eastern Turks nor the faults of the Tang frontier system, and those two problems were closed in the end, one by the internal collapse of the Turks and the other by the Tang court's own reform of its institutions.
